audit.why: Ranged mage vs melee: Karma owns Level 1 with Inner Flame at 950 range against Riven's 275-range Q, Riven owns Levels 2-5 once Ki Burst is up, and Mantra swings Level 6. Difficulty 7.5/10 matches a 53.12% Riven win rate over 3236 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 was listed as 'Skill' in both layers while the packet levelChart says Riven, and the mirror (karma vs riven) already resolved that row to Riven.
audit.why: Karma has no dash and no escape; Riven's W Ki Burst comes online at 2 with an 11s rank-1 cooldown and hard CC. The row is not a coin flip.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side and win[1] both flipped Skill -> Riven as a matched pair, rating raised to 7/10. All other six rows already agree with the packet and the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly claims Mantra empowers Karma's Q into 'a root-plus-tether' (whys[4], spikes[2].text, wants.foe[1]). Riot's own text puts the root on Focused Resolve (W); the Mantra bonus on W extends the root AND heals Karma. The Mantra bonus on Q is a delayed cataclysm, no root at all.
audit.why: Advising the player to fear a root from Mantra-Q sends them dodging the wrong spell and eating the real one. Focused Resolve is 675 range on a flat 12s cooldown and 'if the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted' — Riven's Q dashes and E are exactly the break tool, which the page never states.
audit.corrected: Root and heal attributed to Focused Resolve / Mantra-W; Mantra-Q named as the delayed cataclysm; the tether-break with a Q dash stated explicitly; 675 range and the flat 12s cooldown added where advice keys to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, despite Mantra-W healing Karma mid-trade.
audit.why: Flagged by missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal. Extended trades are decided by whether the heal lands.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds (Executioner's Calling) written into wants.you[1], replacing an invented 'Inspire signals Mantra is spent' tell that is not in the kit.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags 'Focused Resolve's' in whys[1] as a probable wrong name. It is a false positive — Focused Resolve is Karma's real W in the kit file.
audit.corrected: No change; recorded so the defect is not chased again.

edits.after: Mantra-W extends her Focused Resolve root and heals her; Mantra-Q is a delayed cataclysm — read the golden halo and never dash in blind.
